biggest_catch: The only official page is Firstrade's October 2019 launch announcement — Firstrade publishes no current value terms for the free stock. Third-party trackers (September 2026) describe the live program as one free stock worth $3–$200 with roughly 98% odds of landing in the $3–$10 range, so an ordinary user should expect a few dollars, not a windfall. You also need a referral link from a current customer — there is no public signup path.
catches: The official page is a 2019 launch announcement; it states the program mechanics but no stock value or odds — expect it may have changed since.

Per third-party trackers as of September 2026, the free stock is typically worth $3–$10 (about 98% of cases); do not treat the official '1-in-100 Apple/Facebook/Microsoft' line as the ordinary outcome.
Requires a referral link from an existing customer; no public landing page or app-only enrollment path exists for this program.
Third-party sources say the stock must be claimed within 60 days and deposits around a week after approval — those timings are NOT in the official terms.
Firstrade's 2022 blog post described a separate cash bonus (e.g. $50 for $5,000) that expired in November 2022 — do not confuse it with the current referral program.
